skeleton_text: MATCH (HOLE_NODE1:HOLE_LABEL1) WHERE ID(HOLE_NODE1) IN HOLE_VARIABLE1 MATCH (HOLE_NODE2:HOLE_LABEL2)<-[HOLE_REL1:HOLE_RELTYPE1]-(HOLE_NODE1:HOLE_LABEL1) OPTIONAL MATCH (HOLE_NODE1:HOLE_LABEL1)<-[HOLE_REL2:HOLE_RELTYPE2]-(HOLE_NODE3:HOLE_LABEL3) OPTIONAL MATCH (HOLE_NODE3:HOLE_LABEL3)-[HOLE_REL3]->(HOLE_NODE4:HOLE_LABEL4)-[HOLE_REL4:HOLE_RELTYPE2]->(HOLE_NODE1:HOLE_LABEL1) OPTIONAL MATCH (HOLE_NODE1:HOLE_LABEL1)<-[HOLE_REL5:HOLE_RELTYPE3]-(HOLE_NODE5:HOLE_LABEL5) RETURN collect(DISTINCT HOLE_NODE1) AS HOLE_ALIAS1, collect(DISTINCT HOLE_NODE2) AS HOLE_ALIAS2, collect(DISTINCT HOLE_NODE3) AS HOLE_ALIAS3, collect(DISTINCT HOLE_NODE4) AS HOLE_ALIAS4, collect(DISTINCT HOLE_NODE5) AS HOLE_ALIAS5, collect(DISTINCT HOLE_REL1) AS HOLE_ALIAS6, collect(DISTINCT HOLE_REL2) AS HOLE_ALIAS7, collect(DISTINCT HOLE_REL3) AS HOLE_ALIAS8, collect(DISTINCT HOLE_REL4) AS HOLE_ALIAS9, collect(DISTINCT HOLE_REL5) AS HOLE_ALIAS10
